brief.goal: 为 Codex 多模态实验台生成一组可用于页面和文档的概念图。
brief.audience: 项目开发者、内容创作者、工作流测试者

structured_prompt.zh: 一个本地 AI 创作实验台，深色工作界面中展示图片分析报告、Prompt 卡片和概念图资产，整体克制、专业、有创造力，强调可验证工作流。
structured_prompt.en: A local AI creative lab interface on a dark workspace, showing an image analysis report, structured prompt cards, and concept art assets, restrained, professional, inventive, emphasizing a verifiable workflow.
structured_prompt.negative: no external API logos, no fake brand marks, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no noisy clutter

shot_list.framing: wide landscape composition with generous negative space
shot_list.visual_notes: dark studio desk, luminous analysis panels, one polished generated concept image preview
abstract assistant presence, calm intelligence, no literal robot cliche
screenshots transform into structured storyboard panels and image assets

acceptance_checks: 能从 prompt-pack 追溯来源
